# Conxiea

> AI-powered network automation and IT infrastructure services for businesses across the UK.

Conxiea is a UK-based technology company with over 20 years of experience delivering AI network automation, managed infrastructure, and business connectivity solutions. We help IT teams and business owners move from reactive, manual network operations to proactive, automated infrastructure — reducing downtime, cutting manual overhead, and improving security across multi-vendor environments.

Our clients include offices, SMBs, and enterprise teams across the UK who need reliable networks, faster incident resolution, and infrastructure that scales without adding headcount.

## Who We Help

- IT managers and network engineers who need to reduce alert fatigue and manual workload
- Business owners experiencing slow, unreliable, or insecure office or café WiFi
- Operations and infrastructure leads looking to automate repetitive network tasks
- Decision-makers evaluating AIOps, network automation platforms, or managed IT services

## Core Services

- [AI Network Automation Platform — InfraOps](https://conxiea.com/infraaiops): Conxiea's flagship AI-driven platform for network operations. Provides automated monitoring, root cause analysis, self-healing infrastructure, configuration management, and natural language querying of your network. Reduces ticket volume by up to 75:1, cuts mean time to detect by 85%, and delivers 5.25x ROI. Supports Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, and cloud environments.
- [Network Automation Services UK](https://conxiea.com/services): Comprehensive IT services including AI-driven network automation, firewall migrations, cloud network automation, network engineering automation, Active Directory cloud migrations, and advanced troubleshooting.
- [Office WiFi Solutions](https://conxiea.com/office-connectivity): Professional office WiFi design and deployment for UK businesses. Covers site surveys, access point placement, network segmentation, guest/staff separation, and full configuration. Fixes dead zones, dropped calls, and slow speeds permanently.
- [Café WiFi Installation](https://conxiea.com/cafewifi): Reliable connectivity solutions for cafés and hospitality venues. Ensures POS systems, card payments, and customer WiFi stay online during peak hours.
- [Network Troubleshooting](https://conxiea.com/networktroubleshooting): Fast, expert network diagnosis and resolution by certified network engineers — not a helpdesk. Covers intermittent dropouts, slow performance, and persistent faults that other providers cannot fix.
- [Missed Call Text-Back](https://conxiea.com/missedcalltextback): Automated missed-call text-back service. Turns every missed call into a text conversation for lead capture and appointment booking — 24/7.
- [Website Design for Businesses](https://conxiea.com/websites): Professional websites for businesses including tradespeople, electricians, and service companies. Includes domain, hosting, SEO, and lead generation optimisation.
- [AI Chatbots & Automation](https://conxiea.com/services): Custom AI chatbot and automation solutions for business enquiry handling, lead qualification, and customer communication.

## Key Differentiators

- Network engineers with 20+ years of hands-on experience — not a helpdesk or reseller
- AI-native approach: automation is built into how we operate, not bolted on
- Multi-vendor expertise: Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, AWS, Azure
- UK-based team with real-world infrastructure experience
- Performance guarantee: if your office WiFi isn't measurably better after we leave, you don't pay
